description: Finds VA-accredited representatives for a disability claim or appeal, filtered by state, city and type. Results list free Veterans Service Organization (VSO) representatives first, then accredited claims agents and attorneys. Attorneys and agents may generally charge for work after notice of the initial VA decision, subject to VA fee rules and a written agreement. Not legal advice; not affiliated with the VA.
